text: FAA guidance: when a loss of control link occurs, try to reestablish the control link and start emergency or contingency procedures if it cannot be reestablished; preflight briefings must include control link loss procedures. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: if the C2 link is lost, the drone enters a reconnection state and may return to the remote if reconnected within 10 seconds; during automatic RTH caused by signal loss, it will continue to attempt reconnect; if the link is lost more than 10 seconds, the programmed Signal Loss Action is executed, and if connection returns during RTH, RTH completes. Incident reports: unverified accounts claim total loss of control and flyaway, with RTH failures and the platform not recovered.
